terms.t1Body: By accessing or using Aqarico, you confirm that you have read, understood, and agreed to these terms. If you do not agree, please discontinue use of the platform. We may update these terms from time to time — continued use after any changes means you accept them.
terms.t2Body: You are solely responsible for the accuracy and completeness of any listing or information you post. This includes property details, pricing, images, and contact information. Providing misleading or fraudulent content is strictly prohibited and may lead to immediate account suspension or permanent termination.
terms.t3Body: You may not use Aqarico to post duplicate, spam, or fabricated listings. You may not scrape, copy, or redistribute platform content without written permission. Any attempt to manipulate listings, search results, or other users is a violation of these terms.
terms.t4Body: Aqarico reserves the right to review, edit, or remove any listing or content that violates these terms — including false property details, offensive images, or pricing intended to mislead. We may act without prior notice when we believe a violation is serious.
terms.t5Body: Aqarico is a marketplace platform only. All negotiations, agreements, and transactions happen directly between buyers, sellers, and agents. We are not a party to any real estate deal and hold no liability for the outcome of any transaction, dispute, or financial loss arising from listings on the platform.
terms.t6Body: We reserve the right to suspend or permanently terminate any account that violates these terms, engages in abusive behavior, or poses a risk to other users — with or without prior warning depending on severity.
terms.p1Body: When you register or use Aqarico, we collect information you provide directly — such as your name, email address, phone number, and property listings. We also collect basic usage data (pages visited, search queries) to improve the platform experience.
terms.p2Body: Your information is used to operate your account, display your listings, and provide relevant property recommendations. We do not sell your personal data to third parties. We may share limited data with service providers strictly to deliver platform features.
terms.p3Body: Aqarico uses browser storage to remember your session, preferences, and filter settings. This keeps your experience consistent across visits. You can clear this data at any time through your browser settings.
terms.p4Body: We take reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your data from unauthorized access, loss, or misuse. Passwords are hashed and never stored in plain text. However, no system is completely immune to risk — we encourage you to use a strong, unique password.
terms.p5Body: You can access, edit, or delete your account and all associated data at any time through the Settings page. If you want your data permanently removed from our servers, submit a deletion request and we will process it within 14 days.
terms.p6Body: For any privacy concerns or data requests, reach out to us directly through the platform. We take these matters seriously and will respond promptly.
terms.a1Body: By using Aqarico, you commit to posting only properties you have the right to list, with accurate details, real photos, and truthful pricing. You will not impersonate agents, agencies, or other users, or misrepresent your identity or role.
terms.a2Body: You agree to comply with all applicable Egyptian real estate laws, regulations, and local ordinances when listing or transacting on the platform. Aqarico does not verify the legal status of any listed property and is not responsible for compliance failures on the part of any user.
terms.a3Body: Any content you upload — photos, descriptions, documents — remains yours. By posting it on Aqarico, you grant us a non-exclusive, royalty-free license to display, store, and distribute that content within the platform. We will not use your content for advertising outside of Aqarico without your consent.
terms.a4Body: Any disputes between users — over a listing, a transaction, or a deal gone wrong — are handled between those parties directly. Aqarico may assist in investigating serious misconduct reported through the platform, but we are not an arbitration body and our decisions are not legally binding.
terms.a5Body: We may revise this agreement as the platform evolves. When we do, we'll update the date at the top of this page. Material changes will be communicated via email or an in-app notice. Your continued use of Aqarico after that point means you accept the revised agreement.
